title: Trojan Hippo Bench: A Dynamic Benchmark for Persistent Memory Attacks and Defenses in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.01970v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Memory systems enable otherwise stateless LLM agents to persist user information across sessions, but also introduce a new attack surface. The Trojan Hippo attack is a class of persistent memory attacks that operates under a more realistic threat model than prior memory poisoning work. The attacker plants a dormant payload into an agent's long-term memory via a single untrusted tool call (e.g., a crafted email), which activates only when the user later discusses sensitive topics such as finance, health, or identity, and exfiltrates high-value personal data to the attacker. While anecdotal demonstrations of such attacks have appeared against deployed systems, no prior work systematically evaluates them across heterogeneous memory architectures and defenses. translated_abstract: 内存系统使原本无状态的大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够在会话之间持久化用户信息，但同时也引入了新的攻击面。特洛伊河马攻击是一类持久性内存攻击，其运行的威胁模型比以往的内存投毒工作更为现实。攻击者通过一次不可信的工具调用（例如一封精心构造的电子邮件），将休眠载荷植入智能体的长期记忆中，该载荷仅在用户后续讨论金融、健康或身份等敏感话题时才会被激活，并将高价值的个人数据泄露给攻击者。尽管已有针对已部署系统的此类攻击的个别实例演示，但此前尚无工作在异构内存架构和防御措施上对它们进行系统性评估。我们提出了Trojan Hippo Bench，一个针对持久性内存攻击和内存层防御的动态评估框架，包含两个组成部分：(1) 基于OpenEvolve的自动……
tldr: 提出了Trojan Hippo Bench动态评估框架，首次系统性地评测LLM智能体中的持久性内存攻击——即通过单次不可信工具调用植入休眠载荷、在用户讨论敏感话题时激活并窃取高价值个人数据——以及相应内存层防御的有效性。
en_tdlr: Trojan Hippo Bench is a dynamic evaluation framework that, for the first time, systematically benchmarks persistent memory attacks on LLM agents—where dormant payloads planted via a single untrusted tool call activate upon sensitive topics to exfiltrate high-value personal data—and memory-layer defenses.
